tools.description: Read a messages.jsonl transcript, your own by default, or another profile's (path profile:<category>/<name>), a sub-agent run's (path subagent:<run id>) or a file (path path:<file>). Two modes. Without step it lists one short line per step (turn.step, e.g. 3.2) of the chosen turns: messages cut to a preview, tool calls with their arguments cut, ok or error and the result size; results and reasoning are not listed. With step (3.2 or 3.1-3.4) it returns that step whole, part choosing the call, the result or the reasoning, paged by cursor. Use turns or tail to choose turns, role, tool and search to filter, source backup for the history before the last compaction, cursor to continue.

context.description: With search: how many steps to list on each side of a match. Default 0.

cursor.description: Continue where the previous response stopped; use the cursor it gave. Not with turns, tail, step or part.

part.description: With step: both (default) is a tool call and its result and the text of a message; call is the call and messages only, result the results only, reasoning the reasoning steps only (they are never listed).

path.description: Which transcript to read; omit it for your own (a sub-agent reads its own run). profile:<category>/<name> is another profile in this session and profile:<session>/<category>/<name> one in another session; subagent:<run id> (sub_xxxxxxxx) is a run of your profile, subagent:<category>/<name>/<run id> a run of another profile in this session and subagent:<session>/<category>/<name>/<run id> one of another session; path:<file> is a transcript file by filesystem path (off unless tools.native.transcript.allow_path is true). The header of a read and a not-found error give the exact path to reuse.

role.description: List mode: only steps of this role; tool is a tool call (with its result).

search.description: List mode: only steps whose whole text (a call's arguments and result too) contains this, case-insensitive; the line shows only the preview.

source.description: messages (default) is the live transcript; backup is messages.backup.jsonl, the history before the last compaction.

step.description: Detail mode: read one step whole, 3.2 (turn 3, step 2), or a range 3.1-3.4. Step numbers come from the list. Not with turns, tail, role, tool, search or context.

tail.description: List mode: list the last N turns; the same as turns -N. Not with turns, step or cursor.

tool.description: List mode: only calls of tools whose name matches; * and ? are wildcards (read, exec*).

turns.description: List mode: which turns to list: 3, 3-7, -5 (the last five) or 12- (from turn 12). A turn is a user message and the answer to it. Without turns, tail, step or cursor, the last turn is listed.

tools.name: transcript
